name: GBoard Patches
description: Custom Gboard patches with Gemini AI, Rambler Voice, Writing Tools, themes, and encrypted clipboard history.

patches.name: AI Writing Tools
patches.description: Enable AI writing tools with support for all languages.

patches.name: Add Gboard Signature Bypass
patches.description: Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches.description: Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation and rambler mode.

patches.name: Clipboard History
patches.description: Browse, search, copy and delete the encrypted clipboard items saved by the Secure Clipboard Vault.

patches.name: Disable Cloud Backup
patches.description: Keeps keyboard data and personal dictionary off Google Drive backups.

patches.name: Infinite Clipboard
patches.description: Keep every copied item indefinitely. Removes Gboard's one-hour expiry and the 100-entry clipboard history trim.

patches.name: Package Rename
patches.description: Rename the package so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard, with a custom app name.

patches.name: Performance & Privacy
patches.description: Stops background diagnostics, crash reporting, remote-config sync and the ad reporting widget to reduce wake-ups, network traffic and battery use.

patches.name: Secure Clipboard Vault
patches.description: Persist clipboard history across reboots and app updates in an encrypted, app-private vault protected by Android Keystore.

patches.name: Sound & Haptics
patches.description: Override key press sound volume and vibration duration or amplitude without changing Gboard's own sound and haptics preferences.

patches.name: Unlock All Themes
patches.description: Show every theme in each category at once instead of hiding the rest behind the "Show more" card.
